edits.find: A genetic bone-remodeling disorder of the otic capsule at the fissula ante fenestram — an otospongiotic (hypervascular, resorptive) phase followed by a sclerotic phase that fixes the stapes footplate. Autosomal dominant with ~40% penetrance, onset in the 20s–40s, female 2:1 — so family history is often absent. Estrogen and progesterone accelerate it, which is why it is classically unmasked in pregnancy. Measles virus RNA has been found in otosclerotic foci.
edits.with: Otosclerosis is a genetic bone-remodeling disorder of the otic capsule at the fissula ante fenestram. An otospongiotic (hypervascular, resorptive) phase is followed by a sclerotic phase that fixes the stapes footplate. Autosomal dominant with ~40% penetrance means family history is often absent. Onset is in the 20s–40s, with a female predominance of 2:1. Estrogen and progesterone accelerate it, so it is classically unmasked in pregnancy. Measles virus RNA (ribonucleic acid) has been found in otosclerotic foci.

edits.find: Acute unilateral periorbital pain with ipsilateral autonomic signs — ptosis, miosis, lacrimation, rhinorrhea, conjunctival injection — is a cluster headache, and the autonomic column is what decides the stem. Attacks wake the patient from sleep, peak fast, last ~90 minutes, and recur several times daily for weeks before remitting. Acute treatment is 100% oxygen; sumatriptan aborts attacks but is second-line (slower onset, side effects). Vision stays intact — vision change or a fixed mid-dilated pupil moves the diagnosis to angle-closure glaucoma.
